items.note: N1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the signed exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) and restoration of arbitrary scratch, and the method follows the subtract/compute/restore schedule and forward-inverse-forward composition (741-765). It never gives the neighbour rules or the coefficients (|S∩T| mod 2, (|S∩T|-1)/2) that make the cancellation work, nor the net map (JV+RG)x, so the essential cancellation step is only asserted.

N2 states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with edge operators D_v D_u^{-1}, and derives it by the paper's invariant (stored = frame applied to logical) and the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise linear gate (804-817).

Nested nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} from triple indicators, the sole decreasing edges (central 3->4, loss h) and L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539 are present. The budget itself (L=Ich and sum |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L, 1003-1006) is reduced to 'below W·m'. The derivation omits the residual table, the gate-telescoping argument (1066-1071) and the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines under the bilinear forms (856-870).

N4 states the projection assignments, the endpoint identity M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m and s_b<W_b m; N4.1's deficit N-2L_b gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b. The method says every edge's rank equals its dimension change, which leaves out the N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one (1162-1165), the source of the +N.

Phase frames, one kernel aI+bX_v (or inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c<W_c m, and telescoping to C^{⊗m} with the C=iZC^{-1}Z fix on X_a->Y_a follow the paper's proof (1231-1315): weight additivity mod 4, odd weight of unit vectors. The explicit formula s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c is not written out.

s_b<W_b m, s_c<W_c m, L/N<1/2, deficits >20·2^{-50} and τ=1-2^{-50} with s/W<m^τ are all stated. The exact η values and the step log m<20 that turns the deficit into m^τ>m(1-η) (1332-1338) are missing.

Splits, merges, digit moves, cyclic row splitting into W streams, controlled shifts by cut-and-re-merge and unit multiplication by increasing pieces match the paper's proofs (513-527, 574-604). T2 drops the condition that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time (566-567).

A=E_1ΠE_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, triangular factors as controlled shifts, and each pivot H_i<-H_i+D_j realised with one interchange: exactly the paper's proofs (1375-1392, 1425-1446).

Row splitting into W role streams of volume V/W, Φ_{A_e} on each edge by recursive interchanges, the shear H<-H+D, the three-shear interchange, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved to O(e^τ), and the fixed-tape parking schedule at O(V) per node all follow 1491-1616.
High digits form a row field of range at least W^k, padding to a multiple of W^k, a base-m decomposition with a geometric sum, and binary padding to [q^e] give O(Vu^τ), as in 1649-1734.

Conjugation by P_M, one forward child C^{⊗f} per residual basis vector (s_c in total), inverse children through C^{-1}=-iZCZ, basis changes by row additions, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D match 1848-1931.

Eight packed rotations (3-cycles composing to a parity flip with w restored), each as swap/controlled shift/unswap; a bad set of fraction at most 80(f-1)2^{-K} by a union bound; repair by stable radix sort, using that the two bijections agree off B; the top position by a two-bit XOR; cost O(V(L^τ+1)). This is the paper's proof (2013-2207).

Node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)) with s children of volume V/W, rows from q_0 chunks padded to W^{k_0}, and the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) are present. L2.3 claims the recurrence sums to O(e^λ). That omits the leaves (cutoff e<d^β, F=O(e)), their contribution O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), the bound K<=e^{c/β}, and the condition λ'>max{λ,σ+β(1-σ)} (2402-2444).

Layer cost O(Vd^{λ'}), exact evaluation with Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ guard bits from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, εC_1<1 giving Δ=o(p), and one truncation with error <√2·2^{-p} follow the guard-width section and proof (2450-2758).

Character cancellation by the shift t/2^{v+1}, DIF butterflies, bit-reversed storage B_t, the reversed opposite procedure, the layout L by prefix moves and Dq-1 chunk exchanges, per-round layer calls, monomials, truncation commuting with J_E, and the cost/error bounds all match.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, centered-residue extraction (|h_j|<B_0/2), negacyclic reduction and truncation, as in 3233-3368.
Retained LB order, which commutes with pointwise products; signed-packed products; the opposite transform; exact scaling by M=T/r; and the error 3δ+η scaled by M. Error and cost bounds as stated.

P_sF_s=2^{2α^2}B_0P_tF_tA from the HvdH identity and Neumann inverse with absorbed normalisations, approximations with error <p^2, the tensor identity, and axis exposure costing O(Tp d^2(1+ℓ^τ)), following 3576-3642 and 3836-3897.
Chirp identity by coefficient comparison and R cancellation via R F^+ R = F^+ and the normalised convolution rule, exactly as 3938-3983.

Fixed exponents, b, p, d, K, T, t_i, α, γ, the prime intervals, gcd=1, T/2<S<T and trial-division search match 4004-4171. η=1/(4d) is never given, so the interval and separation conditions refer to an unspecified η.

Φ:x->∏x_i^{μ_i} with μ_i=P_i^{-1}, the isomorphism, triangular updates as prefix-controlled cyclic shifts from i=d down, and axis reversal by chunk swaps at O(Tp d^2(1+ℓ^τ)). The explicit b_i formula is only described as triangular.
x_d->ζy is well defined and diagonal, the wrap factor ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, and twist/convolve/untwist with approximations within 2·2^{-p}, as in 4303-4392.

The source transform (A, chirp, B_0, 2^γ) with exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate opposite procedure, and the six-step algorithm with its two scalings by S and 2^{2b+4}S explained via (u*v)/S^2 match 4454-4541.
Contraction and bilinear error propagation, E_s=9·2^γTL, G(U·V_1)=(u*v)/S^2 with error (3E_s+2), final error <448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and the carry invariant follow 4557-4790.
The normalised cost table, margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=2^{-181}=2κ, log factors absorbed by p^κ, and a schoolbook cutoff giving O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}), as in 4810-4995.
R only lists 'nlogn-conjecture' among its dependencies. No step states what an eventual lower bound would require or why one machine with ratio tending to zero refutes it (379-387).

errors.says: Method: assign P_U to gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} to X_a's source; 'edge differences are projections onto residuals, whose rank is the dimension change'.
errors.paper: The N source edges of X_a are exceptions: their matrix is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one where the dimension change is zero. This is why s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b rather than W_b m-2N+2L_b.

errors.says: Apply the f-fold forward child 'on each of the s_c residual-basis slots'.
errors.paper: There are m slots. For each edge, one child acts on slot h for each 1<=h<=ρ_edge after conjugation by P_M, and the s_c children are counted over the whole network, not as s_c slots.

errors.says: With exponents chosen so that a=s/W<m^λ, the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) sums to O(e^λ).
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^λ), using a<=m^σ<m^λ and K<=e^{c/β}. Leaves below d^β contribute O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), which is why λ'>max{λ,σ+β(1-σ)} is needed.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the bank-exchange network through frames, labels, the two interfaces and the strict saving to the two recursive tape procedures (interchange and simultaneous layer), then on to the synthetic transforms, Gaussian resampling, chirp/CRT reductions, exact recovery and the cost table, so it reaches the main bound. It thins out in the network section: the label budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich is never written, the rank-one source exceptions behind s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are omitted, and log m<20 is missing from the τ derivation. The layer recurrence also leaves out the leaf contribution that fixes λ'.

steps.note: The exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with restored scratch is stated, and N3 speaks of an m-dimensional F^{⊗3} built from triple indicators. h=100, indexing of the data pairs by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, and N is used in N3.2 without definition.
A common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and each edge applies D_v D_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspace labels of the m-dimensional F^{⊗3}, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h.

N4's method says edge differences are projections onto residuals with rank equal to the dimension change. The N source edges of rank one, required content of this step, are absent, and the method's blanket claim is wrong for them.
N4.1's deficit N-2L_b is equivalent to s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b. The budget sum |Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are never stated (N3 says only 'below W·m'), and there is no account of how the budget becomes s_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, give the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm.
M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m with the X_a computation P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, so the network applies the same shear H<-H+D on every row/role.
A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge, and s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} from deficits >20·2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^τ). The log m<20 link (1332-1338) is missing but the chain's content is present.

central.summary: The plan carries the central saving's mechanism: frames, nested labels with a single decreasing edge type, loss ratios below 1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving the shear, rank-a shears costing a recursive calls, and the s/W<m^τ recurrence. It is thin at both ends of the count. The fixed network's parameters (h=100, triples, N, m=h^3) are missing, and so are the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich and the rank-one source exceptions that turn it into s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b. Six of nine steps are reconstructed.
